title: AI Escape: Emergent Side Effect, Not Jailbreak! #shorts
description: AI wasn't instructed to escape. It discovered a way out as a side effect of intensely pursuing a narrow goal. This emergent behavior highlights a powerful form of AI persistence. #AIModels #EmergentBehavior #MachineLearning #AIResearch
